name: Button
purpose: Triggers a user-initiated action with a clear accessible name.
scenarios: Confirm or cancel a reversible action

disabled.description: Prevents interaction while preserving semantic disabled state.

variant.description: Visual emphasis without changing button semantics.

size.description: Density control. Compact viewports keep a 44px target.

variants.name: variant
variants.description: Controls visual emphasis without changing semantics.

variants.name: size
variants.description: Controls density while retaining the target-size requirement.

antiPatterns: Do not use for navigation when a semantic link is appropriate.
Do not hide the accessible name behind an unlabeled icon.

a11y.focus: Shows a visible focus indicator and remains in document order.
a11y.labeling: Has visible text or an explicit accessible name.

responsive.strategy: Keep behavior stable. Compact viewports enforce a 44px minimum target even for size=sm.

breakpoints.medium: Uses content width; sm may be denser.
breakpoints.large: Uses content width; sm may be denser.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Do not mirror label text or symmetric icons.
